name: vfe2b-orchestrators
title: Awesome-agent-orchestrators overlay
rule: Embed orchestrator patterns onto existing vfe2b crews and vfharness. Do not install a second orchestrator.

picks.name: Orca
picks.pattern: isolate a job, handoff vs supervise, three terminal states
picks.note: Already the משמרת overlay. Pattern only. Do not brew-install orca.

picks.name: herdr
picks.pattern: pulse: working / blocked / idle on one job
picks.note: Card field דופק only. Do not install a tmux multiplexer.

picks.name: Fusion
picks.pattern: plan → review → execute gates on one mission
picks.note: Harness loop already is the gate. No hierarchical swarm runtime.

picks.name: kodo
picks.pattern: a separate pass verifies the result before done
picks.note: אימות = sensor or named field check. Not a second coding agent.

picks.name: tutti
picks.pattern: typed artifact handoff on disk between steps
picks.note: ארטיפקט path required. No inter-agent mailbox server.

picks.name: gastown
picks.pattern: coordinator + health watchdog + no silent merge
picks.note: Circuit breaker already: three misses → stop. No 20-agent fleet.

picks.name: 5dive
picks.pattern: named roles escalate to a human over chat
picks.note: Human WhatsApp 050-2517000. No Telegram bot from HQ.

picks.name: paperclip
picks.pattern: approval gates and budgets before a worker claims a ticket
picks.note: decision_gate for sale ₪. No unattended ticket claimer.

picks.name: fractal
picks.pattern: bounded retry: depth, cost, time
picks.note: AGENTS.md loop: 2 retries then escalate. No recursive child-agent farm.

picks.name: MartinLoop
picks.pattern: cap spend, verify, roll back, leave a receipt
picks.note: Checkpoint under vfharness/state is the receipt. No unattended spend.

picks.name: ralph-claude-code
picks.pattern: exit detection — stop when the work is actually finished
picks.note: worker_done only after אימות. No Ralph loop on ₪ or send.

picks.name: ralphex
picks.pattern: fresh context per retry; do not keep guessing
picks.note: Retry re-reads the source. Missing stays חסר.

picks.name: Taskuary
picks.pattern: triage inbox into one supervised run
picks.note: Gmail read then one job. HQ may send the 07:00 brief. No unattended queue drain.

picks.name: NEEDLE
picks.pattern: explicit state machine; no side channel
picks.note: Exactly one מצב. Coordination is the card, not a second bus.

picks.name: Crewplane
picks.pattern: reviewable Markdown workflow + resume from completed nodes
picks.note: Guides + checkpoint. Do not install their CLI.

picks.name: LionClaw
picks.pattern: durable workers with explicit state, skills, checkpoints
picks.note: vfharness/state is the control plane. No extra daemon.

picks.name: Open Multi-Agent
picks.pattern: coordinator turns a goal into steps; approvals and resume
picks.note: One existing crew, not a DAG of many coding agents. Embed: planned_steps + gate on checkpoint; playbooks/oma-patterns.md.

picks.name: Claudexor
picks.pattern: quota-aware rotation between desks
picks.note: Grok quota → HQ tools same turn (SEND.md). No subscription rotator binary.

picks.name: humanlayer
picks.pattern: human-in-the-loop gate on hard problems
picks.note: ₪ and customer WhatsApp stay human. Repo itself is largely deprecated — keep the gate, skip the install.

picks.name: ivy-tendril
picks.pattern: plan-based lifecycle with verification and human checkpoints
picks.note: Same as Fusion + kodo on one crew. No extra ADE.

picks.name: Dex
picks.pattern: human-gated plan, then a review loop that can stop at a dead end
picks.note: Planner questions first. Dead end = חסר, not an invented body.

picks.name: Julius / books verify
picks.pattern: ask existing numbers; verify the citation before answering
picks.note: Already in the e2b catalog. Orchestrator add: אימות on the cited file.

picks.name: amux
picks.pattern: parallel coding agents in git worktrees
picks.note: Second coding office. Cursor is the desk.

picks.name: OpenClaw
picks.pattern: always-on personal assistant across chat apps
picks.note: 24/7 assistant + WhatsApp/Telegram. Human close stays 050-2517000.

picks.name: loki-mode
picks.pattern: 41 agents in 8 swarms
picks.note: Unattended swarm. Five seats already exist.

picks.name: bernstein
picks.pattern: keep running until tests pass with no model in the coordinator
picks.note: Unattended loop. Sensors stay computational and bounded.

picks.name: takopi
picks.pattern: Telegram bridge to coding agents
picks.note: No customer-chat bot from HQ.

picks.name: claude-code-action
picks.pattern: GitHub Action implements or reviews from issue context
picks.note: Lead seat would have to open Actions. Not a studio floor job.

picks.name: denchclaw
picks.pattern: CRM / sales automation / outreach
picks.note: No auto-outreach. No auto-DM.
